header: Where the figures in this chapter come from
text: Some elements here count Astryx for TYPO3 itself, from its code and its release notes. The others show example figures and say so in their notes. Nothing is measured when the page loads: an editor typed every number.
note: Counts are as at version 2.4. A later release can change them, and its release notes say how.
